description: Use when the user asks: 'list creators in PICA', 'people starting with B', 'browse the people directory'. Browse and filter creators in the PICA public directory. Filter by free-text (q), ISNI, IPI, or starting letter (A–Z, or '#' for numeric). Returns paginated results. Each result carries global_creator_id, the ID directory_lookup_person takes. → then: directory_lookup_person (identifiers, roles, listed-work count and collaborators for one creator)

letter.description: Filter by last name starting letter (A–Z), or '#' for numeric

name: directory_list_people
title: List creators
